title: Traffic Stewardship Runbook and Ops Checklist (WIP)
body:
Purpose:

This is a working runbook for cross-functional traffic stewardship — the operational playbook and checklist that product, SRE, observability, and solutions engineering use when activating new LLM features, model variants, or routing policies. Focus is on: safe traffic activation, measurable rollback gates, cost/loss guardrails, and clear handoffs.

Audience and scope:
- Audience: product owners, oncall SRE, release engineers, solutions eng, data/analytics partner.
- Scope: staged canaries, small-batch A/B experiments, dual-path mirroring for canary + shadow, and emergency reversion. Not a full A/B statistical design doc (see linked artifacts).

Quick summary (one-liner):
- Move slowly, measure early signals, cap cost/latency drift, and require two-party signoff for any traffic expansion beyond 10%.

Activation runway (recommended phases):
1) Internal smoke (0% external traffic) — run internal synthetic traffic and golden prompts. Duration: 2 business days.
2) Micro-canary (0.1% traffic or 1000 requests/day whichever first) — high-signal slices only (power users, internal beta cohort). Duration: min 24h, monitor real-time guardrails.
3) Nano-scale A/B (1% traffic) — balanced assignment by cohort; run 48–72h for stable metrics.
4) Step expansions (1% -> 5% -> 20%) — each step requires green signals for 48h after statistically meaningful sample.
5) Broad exposure (>20%) — product/exec approval and billing/ops sync.

Guardrails and gates (required checks before any expansion):
- Safety: no new top-10 safety violation increases by >0.5% absolute in cohort signals.
- Latency: P95 increase <= 40ms vs baseline or absolute P95 <= 600ms (whichever stricter).
- Error rate: API 5xx increase <= 0.05 percentage points.
- Cost: incremental per-token cost delta <= 15% of baseline for the same traffic distribution unless explicitly budgeted.
- Quality: regression on core prompt set (eval harness) <= 1.5% drop in accuracy/score.
- User impact: critical downstream business metrics (checkout completion, retention) show no regression at 95% CI.

Operational signals (what to monitor, dashboards):
- Serving metrics: P50/P95/P99 latency by model variant, request size histogram, GPU utilization per pool.
- Cost metrics: tokens-per-request trend, per-route token spend, projected 7-day burn delta.
- Behavioral metrics: eval-suite pass rate for golden prompts, hallucination classifier rate, safety flagging rate.
- Business metrics: conversion funnel slice, retention by cohort, CS escalations.
- Health: 5xx counts, KC (kv) cache hit ratio, queue depth/backpressure.

Signal math examples (explicit formulas):
- Projected incremental cost = (new_tokens_per_req - baseline_tokens_per_req) * avg_requests_per_day * token_cost.
- Max cost exposure = baseline_daily_cost * 1.15 (hard stop unless finance approves).
- Risk budget (RB) = baseline_error_rate + 0.02; if observed_error_rate > RB -> auto-hold.

Traffic partitioning guidance (examples):
- Risk-first experiments: sample by microcohorts tied to internal beta flag; choose coherent business units to isolate blast radius.
- Representative A/B: stratify on device, geography, and user age bucket to ensure even splits for downstream metrics.
- Canary slices: choose high-signal cohorts (power users, internal accounts) plus an orthogonal low-signal slice (random 0.1%) to detect regressions not surfaced by power users.

Experiment patterns (practical ops patterns we use):
- Shadow+Canary dual-mode: send mirrored requests to new variant for logging/metric calc; only a small percentage are returned to users. Good for previewing unseen failures.
- Progressive mirroring: 100% mirror but throttled analysis pipeline to avoid storage spikes; used for expensive quality checks.
- Synthetic burst tests: generate controlled bursts with golden prompts to test tail-latency/backpressure.
- Hot-fallback matrices: map model variant -> fallback vendor/variant for each severity level (latency, quality, cost).

Comms and decision protocol (who signs what):
- Stage owners: product PM (risk and hypothesis), release engineer (activation), oncall SRE (health), analytics lead (statistical validation).
- Signoff gates: micro-canary -> PM + SRE sign; expansion >5% -> PM + SRE + analytics; >20% -> exec + finance + security.
- Notification channels: #rollouts-notify for step announcements; tie alerts to pager duty only for critical health failures.

Handoff checklist (before any handoff or ramp):
- [ ] Jira ticket with rollout plan and exposure steps linked.
- [ ] Dashboard with baseline and delta widgets created and shared.
- [ ] Cost projection for 7/30 day horizons attached.
- [ ] Regression eval snapshot (commit hash + prompts) stored.
- [ ] Rollback playbook updated with exact command/route to shift (include API endpoints and console steps).
- [ ] Communication plan: in-product banner copy, support scripts, known-issue FAQ.

Automated rollback triggers (recommended):
- Latency P95 breach for 5 consecutive minutes above threshold.
- Error rate increase breaching RB for 15 minutes.
- Daily projected cost delta > 150% of allowances (safety multiplier).
- Safety classifier spike > 3x baseline in top categories.

Runbook snippets (operational commands and quick references):
- Quick revert (console): Toggle traffic split for model X from variant B -> variant A (path: Console > Deployments > Model X > Set split).
- CLI revert: redwood-cli rollout adjust --model X --variant A --split 100
- Emergency: open incident in PagerDuty, tag "rollout-incident", page SRE primary, product oncall; OOO template in incident notes points to this file.

Observability notes (panels and minimal queries):
- Panel: Latency by variant — group by variant, show P50/P95, overlay baseline.
- Panel: Cost burn — per-route token spend, cumulative 7d projection.
- Alert rule: pct_increase(error_rate, 15m) > 0.02 AND abs_delta > 0.01 -> Sev2.

Post-mortem / rollback post-checks (after a revert):
- Confirm traffic fully reverted and no residual failed requests in queue.
- Re-run golden prompt eval against latest live variant; snapshot results.
- Short synthesis note: 1 paragraph on cause, 2 action items, owner assign.

Open questions / experimental ideas (WIP):
- Can we adopt a dynamic cost throttle that reduces mirrored-sampling rate when projected spend crosses thresholds?
- Investigate lightweight statistical tests tailored to low-traffic micro-canaries (bayesian sequential tests suggested).
- If rollout involves model quantization, add a quantization-specific quality sweep (token-level BLEU/ROUGE on targeted prompts).

Notes to self (loose):
- Keep the default micro-canary size conservative; many regressions only show up after 10k+ unique users.
- Build a tiny smoke harness for long-tail hallucination detection (heuristic + manual sample).
- Make sure finance can multiplex short-term credits for burst cost from sandbox.

Version history / edits:
- 2025-11-03 initial draft by PK.
- 2025-12-10 added cost projection formulas (Ethan).
- 2026-01-25 expanded automated rollback triggers (Maya).
- 2026-02-28 added comms checklist + linked artifacts (Noah).

If you are about to expand traffic and are unsure: ping me (Priya) in #rollouts and attach the preflight checklist. We will fast-track a 30-min safety sync before any >5% expansion.
